headlines.title: Visa and Octopus Expand QR Payment Acceptance in Hong Kong, Enabling Tourists to Pay Like They Do at Home
headlines.summary: Visa, a global leader in digital payments, today announced the expansion of Visa Scan to Pay acceptance in Hong Kong through a partnership with Octopus Cards Limited (Octopus), one of Hong Kong's leading everyday payment platforms, enabling Visa-powered QR payments at Octopus QR merchants across the city[1].

headlines.title: Visa (V) Ties Monad Stablecoin Settlement Move To New Fraud API Rollout
headlines.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has added the Monad blockchain to its stablecoin settlement program as a new multi-chain option. Global Payments is integrating Visa's IDX API into its Adaptive Authentication service to support identity and fraud checks for clients. Both moves signal Visa's push to expand blockchain-based settlement tools and strengthen digital transaction security for payment partners.

headlines.title: Visa adds Monad to stablecoin settlement options
headlines.summary: Scott Melker discusses Visa (V) adding Monad as yet another option for settlecoin settlements. Visa already allows settlements on ethereum (ETH-USD), Solana (SOL-USD), and Avalanche (AVAX-USD). "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

headlines.title: Can Visa's Monad Integration Boost Its Stablecoin Strategy?
headlines.summary: V expands its stablecoin settlement network with Monad, enhancing blockchain flexibility as settlement volumes surge and institutional adoption gains momentum.

headlines.title: Wall Street hits the night shift thanks to Okxice, and Kraken puts daq in your wallet
headlines.summary: Scott Melker discusses Okxice's plans for a Nov. 23 launch under an SEC innovation exemption; Kraken (KRAK.PVT) to launch Nasdaq-backed tokenized versions of European stocks; and Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citi (C) among the banks committing to stablecoin ventures. description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
